title: Fees on the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy and Courtesy Fee Waivers
content:
Four fees exist on the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, and each is charged only as stated here. The amounts are those of the policy's package; a fee whose package amount is 0.00 is not charged at all.

## The four fees

| Fee | When it is charged |
|---|---|
| Installment fee | on each installment after the first: the package's EFT installment fee on the monthly EFT plan, and the package's direct-bill installment fee on the two-pay and quarterly plans; annual and mortgagee escrow terms carry no installment fee |
| Late fee | once per installment, only when the installment is still unpaid after the late-fee grace period |
| Returned-payment fee | once for each payment returned by the bank, referencing that returned payment |
| Reinstatement fee | once, when a cancelled policy is reinstated |

No late fee or returned-payment fee is ever charged on a mortgagee-billed term.

## Late-fee grace period

A late fee is charged only when the installment is still unpaid after the late-fee grace period that starts on the installment due date. The grace period is the package's late-fee grace days, counted in calendar days from the due date recorded on the installment, so the late fee may be posted from the day after the due date plus the grace days. On the last day of the grace period itself no late fee is posted.

An installment is still unpaid when the amount due on that day still includes any part of it, payments having been applied to the oldest charge first.

**Amount due** on a given day is: the premium installments billed whose due date is on or before that day, together with fees assessed, returned payments, additional premium and refunds issued posted on or before that day, less payments received, fees waived and return premium posted on or before that day; it is never below 0.00.

*Hypothetical boundary pair (grace of 10 days, installment due 10 March):* the due date plus 10 days is 20 March. On 20 March no late fee may be posted; from 21 March a late fee may be posted if the amount due that day still includes part of the installment.

## Courtesy waivers

- On the named insured's request, a late fee or a returned-payment fee may be waived as a courtesy.
- A courtesy waiver is granted only while the policy's waivers in the rolling 12 months are fewer than the package's courtesy waiver allowance. The count is of fee waivers posted on the policy whose posted date is later than the waiver date less 12 calendar months and on or before the waiver date, as the billing records show.
- A fee that has already been waived is never waived again.
- Installment fees and reinstatement fees are never waived.
- A waiver always removes the full amount of the one fee entry it references; a fee is never partly waived.

| Request | Waivers already posted in the rolling 12 months | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Waive a late fee, allowance 1 (hypothetical) | 0 | may be waived in full |
| Waive a late fee, allowance 1 (hypothetical) | 1 | not granted |
| Waive a returned-payment fee already waived | any | not waived again |
| Waive an installment fee or a reinstatement fee | any | never waived |

*Hypothetical rolling window:* a waiver posted on 5 April of one year is inside the window for a waiver requested on 4 April of the next year, and outside it for a request on 5 April of the next year.
